你是 Godot 4.7 GDScript 项目 HonorKing（MOBA 游戏）的界面复刻工程师。工作目录：C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king（无 git 仓库，改动不可回滚，务必谨慎）。

背景：单机版（host）的 UI 全部由 scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd（约 3480 行）构建；联机客户端用自绘 Control 复刻 host 面板。用户反馈“联机版和单机版的英雄信息面板不太一样”，你的任务是把联机英雄信息面板（C 键/Tab 面板，含队伍列表页与属性页）对齐单机英雄详情面板。

第一步：先领取共享任务 task-2（team_task_get 读最新 revision，然后 team_task_update action=claim）。任务描述里有完整验收要求，务必遵守。

工作方式（省 token，禁止整文件回显）：
1. 先读 scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd（约 225 行，可整读）；再 grep 定位 UI_Manager.gd 中英雄详情面板相关函数（关键字：_create_hero_detail_panel、_rebuild_hero_detail、_update_hero_detail、hero_detail_panel、hero_detail、_apply_panel_style、_apply_label_style、_apply_rich_label_style、ATTR_ROWS_PER_COL、_build_attr_row、roster），逐个带 offset/limit 定点读。
2. 用 edit 做定点替换，不要 write 重写整个文件；只允许改 scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd，绝不改 NetClientBattle.gd / NetSession.gd / UI_Manager.gd。
3. 保持公开 API 与父场景调用方式不变（NetClientBattle._build_roster_panel 里 new 出来、CanvasLayer 101；调用 show_panel(view)、hide_panel()、rows/own 赋值、_process 内按 REQ_INTERVAL 发请求）。坐标是 2400×1400 虚拟画布；host 的 ui_scale() = maxf(1.0, 视口宽/2400.0)*1.35，复刻同一公式（私有 helper `_us()`），别写死分辨率。
4. 对齐目标：全屏遮罩（若有）、面板位置/尺寸/圆角/底色/描边，标题字号与金色，双方队伍分区（我方/敌方标题与队伍色），英雄卡片尺寸/底色/描边/高亮自己，卡片内名字/等级/血量条/蓝条/KDA 排版，装备图标行，技能行，属性页 18 行两列的行高/列宽/字体/颜色（基础白 #fff、装备绿、增益橙、数值拼接规则），关闭按钮（位置/尺寸/颜色）。若 host 面板结构比现有客户端复杂得多，按 host 结构重排，而不是只调字号。
5. 数据来自 NetSession 的 roster payload（grep NetSession.gd 里 _pack_roster_row、ROSTER 请求相关）与 own 快照。需要 host 补发字段才能完全一致的，保留近似并在完成消息里列出，不要自行改协议。

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

1: class_name NetRosterPanel
2: extends Control
3: ## P3c：接管客户端的「属性 C / 队伍 T」面板——host `_rpc_roster` 行 + own 快照 → 队伍计分板
4: ## （我方 5 / 可见敌方，装备块按 ItemDatabase 解析）+ C 视图自身属性段。
5: ## 只读复刻：不参与模拟、绝不回写 host。面板打开时自驱动 0.5s 节流请求 C_ROSTER。
6: ## 画布与 host 同处 2400×1400 stretch 坐标（NetTargetPanel 同款）。
7: 
8: const REQ_INTERVAL := 0.5
9: const PANEL_W := 2100.0
10: const ROW_H := 104.0
11: const COL_W := 990.0
12: const ROWS_CAP := 5
13: const TEAM_CYAN := Color(0.36, 0.78, 1.0)
14: const TEAM_ORANGE := Color(1.0, 0.58, 0.26)
15: # 属性分段配色（对齐主机 UI_Manager / 客户端 Hud 底部属性面板）
16: const ATTR_BASE_C := Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.96)
17: const ATTR_EQUIP_C := Color(0.42, 0.9, 0.42)
18: const ATTR_BUFF_C := Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.25)
19: const ATTR_NAME_C := Color(0.8, 0.83, 0.87)
20: const ATTR_ROWS_PER_COL := 9
21: 
22: var rows := []        # host roster payload（见 NetSession._pack_roster_row）
23: var own := {}         # 本帧 own 快照（高亮自己）
24: var view := "team"    # "attr" | "team"
25: var _req_at := 0.0
26: var _f := ThemeDB.fallback_font
27: 
28: func _ready() -> void:
29: 	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
30: 	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
31: 	visible = false
32: 
33: func _process(delta: float) -> void:
34: 	if not visible:
35: 		return
36: 	# 打开期间 0.5s 节流拉取 + 读最新行（host 立即回 _rpc_roster）
37: 	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
38: 	if now - _req_at >= REQ_INTERVAL:
39: 		_req_at = now
40: 		NetSession.send_command([NetSession.C_ROSTER])
41: 	rows = NetSession.get_roster_payload()
42: 	queue_redraw()
43: 
44: func _text(pos: Vector2, txt: String, sz: float, col: Color) -> void:
45: 	draw_string(_f, pos + Vector2(1.5, 1.5), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, sz, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5))
46: 	draw_string(_f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, sz, col)
47: 
48: func _panel_h() -> float:
49: 	# 内容：顶部留 140（标题+列头）→ ROWS_CAP×ROW_H 英雄卡 → 下距 24；attr 视图再追加
50: 	# 自身属性段（图例+2 列 ×9 行网格，高 334）。ROWS_CAP×ROW_H 需与卡片绘制起点同基准。
51: 	var body := 140.0 + ROWS_CAP * ROW_H + 24.0
52: 	return body + (334.0 if view == "attr" else 0.0)
53: 
54: func _panel_rect() -> Rect2:
55: 	var vp := get_viewport()
56: 	var area := (vp.get_visible_rect().size if vp != null else size)
57: 	return Rect2((area.x - PANEL_W) * 0.5, 90.0, PANEL_W, _panel_h())
58: 
59: func _draw() -> void:
60: 	var vp := get_viewport()
61: 	if vp == null:
62: 		return
63: 	var area := vp.get_visible_rect().size
64: 	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, area), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55))
65: 	var panel := _panel_rect()
66: 	draw_rect(panel, Color(0.015, 0.035, 0.08, 0.94))
67: 	draw_rect(panel, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14), false, 3.0)
68: 	# 标题 + 关闭 ✕（点此关闭，见 _gui_input）
69: 	_text(panel.position + Vector2(30, 46), "属性" if view == "attr" else "队伍", 34, Color.GOLD)
70: 	_text(panel.position + Vector2(PANEL_W - 100, 46), "✕", 30, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8))
71: 	# 两列：我方(team0) / 可见敌方(team1)
72: 	var self_nid := int(own.get("nid", -1))
73: 	var lx := panel.position.x + 60.0
74: 	var rx := panel.position.x + 60.0 + COL_W + 60.0
75: 	var hy := panel.position.y + 96.0
76: 	_text(Vector2(lx, hy), "我方", 26, TEAM_CYAN)
77: 	_text(Vector2(rx, hy), "敌方", 26, TEAM_ORANGE)
78: 	var ry := panel.position.y + 140.0
79: 	var yl := ry
80: 	var yr := ry
81: 	for e in rows:
82: 		var team := int(e[2])
83: 		if team == 0:
84: 			_draw_hero_card(Vector2(lx, yl), e, self_nid, TEAM_CYAN)
85: 			yl += ROW_H
86: 		else:
87: 			_draw_hero_card(Vector2(rx, yr), e, self_nid, TEAM_ORANGE)
88: 			yr += ROW_H
89: 	if view == "attr":
90: 		_draw_attr_strip(panel, self_nid)
91: 
92: func _draw_hero_card(pos: Vector2, e: Array, self_nid: int, team_col: Color) -> void:
93: 	var card := Rect2(pos, Vector2(COL_W, ROW_H))
94: 	if int(e[0]) == self_nid:
95: 		draw_rect(card, Color(1, 0.85, 0.3, 0.10))
96: 		draw_rect(card, Color(1, 0.85, 0.3, 0.9), false, 2.5)
97: 	_text(pos + Vector2(16, 26), "Lv.%d" % int(e[3]), 22, team_col)
98: 	_text(pos + Vector2(90, 26), str(e[1]), 26, Color(0.95, 0.97, 1.0))
99: 	_text(pos + Vector2(COL_W - 320, 26), "%d / %d / %d" % [int(e[6]), int(e[7]), int(e[8])], 22, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9))
100: 	_text(pos + Vector2(COL_W - 150, 26), "%d 金" % int(e[9]), 20, Color(1, 0.85, 0.45))
101: 	# 血条
102: 	var maxhp := maxf(1.0, float(e[5]))
103: 	var ratio := clampf(float(e[4]) / maxhp, 0.0, 1.0)
104: 	draw_rect(Rect2(pos + Vector2(16, 52), Vector2(300, 10)), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
105: 	draw_rect(Rect2(pos + Vector2(16, 52), Vector2(300 * ratio, 10)), team_col.darkened(0.25))
106: 	# 属性速览（host roster 行 11..15 = 攻/法/甲/抗/速，同主机英雄卡片的彩色数值小字）
107: 	var attrs := [
108: 		["攻", 11, Color(1.0, 0.58, 0.2)],
109: 		["法", 12, Color(0.82, 0.5, 1.0)],
110: 		["甲", 13, Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.32)],
111: 		["抗", 14, Color(0.4, 0.88, 1.0)],
112: 		["速", 15, Color(0.5, 0.93, 0.9)],
113: 	]
114: 	var ax := pos.x + 16.0
115: 	for a in attrs:
116: 		var vi: int = int(a[1])
117: 		var vv := int(e[vi]) if vi < e.size() else 0
118: 		_text(Vector2(ax, pos.y + ROW_H - 18.0), "%s %d" % [str(a[0]), vv], 20, a[2])
119: 		ax += 108.0
120: 	# 装备块（≤6，首 2 字；行加高后移到中段）
121: 	var chips := 0
122: 	for i in range(e[10].size()):
123: 		if chips >= 6:
124: 			break
125: 		var cid := str(e[10][i])
126: 		var item := ItemDatabase.get_item(cid)
127: 		var nm := str(item.get("name", cid)) if not item.is_empty() else cid
128: 		var g := (nm.substr(0, 2) if nm.length() > 0 else "?")
129: 		var cx := pos.x + COL_W - 470.0 + float(chips) * 64.0
130: 		draw_rect(Rect2(cx, pos.y + 38.0, 40, 40), Color(0.12, 0.18, 0.3, 0.9))
131: 		draw_rect(Rect2(cx, pos.y + 38.0, 40, 40), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.2), false, 1.5)
132: 		_text(Vector2(cx + 2.0, pos.y + 66.0), g, 20, Color(0.95, 0.95, 1.0))
133: 		chips += 1
134: 
135: # C 视图底部「自身属性」区：完整 18 行属性表（own.sa 三元组，顺序同 UiManager.ATTRIBUTE_ROWS），
136: # 2 列 × 9 行，基础白/装备绿/加成橙——与主机 C 英雄面板 / 客户端左下属性面板同源同色。
137: func _draw_attr_strip(p: Rect2, self_nid: int) -> void:
138: 	var my := {}
139: 	for e in rows:
140: 		if int(e[0]) == self_nid:
141: 			my = e
142: 			break
143: 	var y0 := p.position.y + 140.0 + ROWS_CAP * ROW_H + 24.0
144: 	draw_line(p.position + Vector2(30, y0 - 12.0), p.position + Vector2(PANEL_W - 30, y0 - 12.0), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.18), 2.0)
145: 	_text(p.position + Vector2(60, y0 + 20), "自身属性（本机接管英雄）", 24, Color(0.5, 0.95, 0.65))
146: 	var sa: Array = own.get("sa", [])
147: 	var cfg: Array = UiManager.ATTRIBUTE_ROWS
148: 	var n := mini(cfg.size(), int(sa.size() / 3))
149: 	if n <= 0:
150: 		if my.is_empty():
151: 			_text(p.position + Vector2(60, y0 + 74), "（尚未获得属性数据）", 20, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6))
152: 		else:
153: 			_text(p.position + Vector2(60, y0 + 74), "（等待 host 推送 own.sa 属性）", 20, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6))
154: 		return
155: 	# 图例
156: 	var legend_x := p.position.x + 90.0
157: 	for lg in [["基础", ATTR_BASE_C], ["  装备", ATTR_EQUIP_C], ["  加成", ATTR_BUFF_C]]:
158: 		var lt: String = str(lg[0])
159: 		_text(Vector2(legend_x, y0 + 46), lt, 18, lg[1])
160: 		legend_x += 130.0
161: 	var row_h := 30.0
162: 	var col_w := 940.0
163: 	var col_gap := 40.0
164: 	var gy := y0 + 64.0
165: 	for i in range(n):
166: 		var c: Dictionary = cfg[i]
167: 		var col := int(i / ATTR_ROWS_PER_COL)
168: 		var ri := i % ATTR_ROWS_PER_COL
169: 		var x0 := p.position.x + 90.0 + float(col) * (col_w + col_gap)
170: 		var mult := float(c.get("mult", 1.0))
171: 		var pct := bool(c.get("pct", false))
172: 		var base := float(sa[i * 3]) * mult
173: 		var equip := float(sa[i * 3 + 1]) * mult
174: 		var buff := float(sa[i * 3 + 2]) * mult
175: 		var ry := gy + float(ri) * row_h + 18.0
176: 		var nm: String = str(c.get("name", ""))
177: 		_text(Vector2(x0, ry), nm, 20, ATTR_NAME_C)
178: 		var tx := x0 + _f.get_string_size(nm, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 20).x + 14.0
179: 		var any := absf(base) > 0.05 or absf(equip) > 0.05 or absf(buff) > 0.05
180: 		if not any:
181: 			_text(Vector2(tx, ry), _attr_txt(base, pct), 20, ATTR_BASE_C)
182: 			continue
183: 		if absf(base) > 0.05:
184: 			var bt := _attr_txt(base, pct)
185: 			_text(Vector2(tx, ry), bt, 20, ATTR_BASE_C)
186: 			tx += _f.get_string_size(bt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 20).x
187: 		if absf(equip) > 0.05:
188: 			var et := "+%s" % _attr_txt(equip, pct)
189: 			_text(Vector2(tx, ry), et, 20, ATTR_EQUIP_C)
190: 			tx += _f.get_string_size(et, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 20).x
191: 		if absf(buff) > 0.05:
192: 			var ft := "+%s" % _attr_txt(buff, pct)
193: 			_text(Vector2(tx, ry), ft, 20, ATTR_BUFF_C)
194: 
195: func _attr_txt(e: float, pct: bool) -> String:
196: 	if pct:
197: 		var r := roundf(e * 10.0) / 10.0
198: 		if absf(r - roundf(r)) < 0.05:
199: 			return "%d%%" % int(roundf(r))
200: 		return "%.1f%%" % r
201: 	return "%d" % int(roundf(e))
202: 
203: func _gui_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
204: 	var press := (ev is InputEventMouseButton and (ev as InputEventMouseButton).pressed and (ev as InputEventMouseButton).button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) or (ev is InputEventScreenTouch and (ev as InputEventScreenTouch).pressed)
205: 	if not press:
206: 		return
207: 	var p := (ev as InputEventMouseButton).position if ev is InputEventMouseButton else (ev as InputEventScreenTouch).position
208: 	var panel := _panel_rect()
209: 	# 右上 ✕ 或面板外 → 关闭（同主机点遮罩关闭）
210: 	if p.x >= panel.position.x + PANEL_W - 150.0 and p.y <= panel.position.y + 80.0:
211: 		hide_panel()
212: 		return
213: 	if not panel.has_point(p):
214: 		hide_panel()
215: 
216: func show_panel(v: String) -> void:
217: 	view = v
218: 	_req_at = 0.0
219: 	visible = true
220: 	rows = NetSession.get_roster_payload()
221: 	queue_redraw()
222: 
223: func hide_panel() -> void:
224: 	visible = false
225: 	queue_redraw()

```gdscript
# host ui_scale() 同公式：宽度基准 2400，叠加 1.35 倍读性放大
func _us() -> float:
	var vp := get_viewport()
	if vp == null:
		return UI_SCALE_EXTRA
	return maxf(1.0, vp.get_visible_rect().size.x / BASE_W) * UI_SCALE_EXTRA

func _fs(base: float) -> float:
```

```gdscript
func _metrics(n: int, avail: float) -> Dictionary:

		return {"h": CARD_MIN_H, "main": 12, "sub": 11}
	var h := maxf(CARD_MIN_H, (1000.0 - TEAM_HDR_H - CARD_GAP * float(n)) / float(n))
```

```gdscript
## 版式对齐 host UI_Manager._create_hero_detail_panel / _refresh_hero_detail_panel：
```
## 全屏 0.4 遮罩 + 居中 2160 宽满高黑底(0.88)面板 + 标题「战场信息」(44,16) 28 金 +
## 副标题 (48,58) 13 灰 + 金线 (44,82) 360×3 + 右上 ×（-56..-6 / 6..56，26 号）+ 团队统计头
## （我方 青 / VS 金 / 敌方 红，font_main+2/+4）+ 按总经济降序的单列英雄卡（圆角 8、队伍底色、
## 左侧 4px 队伍描边、自己加金边）→ 卡内 60px 头像盘 / 状态·名字·Lv / 属性圆徽章行 + 技能行 /
## KDA·总经济·装备行。attr 视图在名单下方追加 host attribute_panel 同款属性表
## （2 列 ×9 行、行高 26s、列宽 200s、基础白 / +装备绿 / +增益橙）。
## 只读复刻：不参与模拟、绝不回写 host。面板打开时自驱动 0.5s 节流请求 C_ROSTER。
## 画布与 host 同处 2400×1400 stretch 坐标；字号与属性表按 host ui_scale() 同公式缩放。

const REQ_INTERVAL := 0.5
const UI_SCALE_EXTRA := 1.35      # 同 host UI_Manager.UI_SCALE_EXTRA
const BASE_W := 2400.0            # host ui_scale() 的基准虚拟宽

# —— host _create_hero_detail_panel 几何（虚拟画布单位，本身不乘 ui_scale）——
const PANEL_W := 2160.0           # offset_left/right = ∓1080
const CONTENT_TOP := 78.0         # scroll.offset_top
const TEAM_HDR_H := 55.0
const CARD_GAP := 4.0             # vbox separation
const CARD_MIN_H := 52.0
const DISC_W := 60.0              # HeroDisc custom_minimum_size.x
const LEFT_W := 180.0             # left_box custom_minimum_size.x
const RIGHT_W := 340.0            # right_box custom_minimum_size.x
const CLOSE_W := 50.0             # close_btn offset -56..-6 / 6..56

# —— host 配色（UI_Manager 同值）——
const C_ALLY := Color(0.0, 0.886, 1.0)
const C_ENEMY := Color(1.0, 0.33, 0.264)
const C_ALLY_BG := Color(0.0, 0.22, 0.4, 0.78)
const C_ENEMY_BG := Color(0.42, 0.07, 0.07, 0.78)
const C_SUB := Color(0.75, 0.78, 0.84, 0.9)
const C_GOLD_LINE := Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.2, 0.3)
const C_OWN_EDGE := Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3, 0.85)
const C_DIM := Color(0, 0, 0, 0.4)
const C_PANEL_BG := Color(0, 0, 0, 0.88)

# —— host attribute_panel 属性表（_create_attribute_panel / _build_attr_row 同值）——
const ATTR_ROWS_PER_COL := 9
const ATTR_ROW_H := 26.0
const ATTR_COL_W := 200.0
const ATTR_GAP := 12.0
const ATTR_PAD := 12.0
const ATTR_LEGEND_H := 24.0
const C_ATTR_NAME := Color(0.92, 0.92, 0.92, 0.95)
const C_ATTR_BASE := Color.WHITE
const C_ATTR_EQUIP := Color(0.45, 0.9, 0.4)
const C_ATTR_BUFF := Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.25)

var rows := []        # host roster payload（见 NetSession._pack_roster_row）
var own := {}         # 本帧 own 快照（高亮自己 / 属性表 own.sa）
var view := "team"    # "attr" | "team"
var _req_at := 0.0
var _f := ThemeDB.fallback_font
var _sb_ally: StyleBoxFlat = null
var _sb_enemy: StyleBoxFlat = null
var _sb_own: StyleBoxFlat = null

func _ready() -> void:
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	visible = false
	_sb_ally = _card_sb(C_ALLY_BG, C_ALLY)
	_sb_enemy = _card_sb(C_ENEMY_BG, C_ENEMY)
	_sb_own = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	_sb_own.bg_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
	_sb_own.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	_sb_own.set_border_width_all(2)
	_sb_own.border_color = C_OWN_EDGE

# host 英雄卡 StyleBox：圆角 8 + 左侧 4px 队伍描边 + 其余 1px，内边距 6/2
func _card_sb(bg: Color, border: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = bg
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	sb.border_width_left = 4
	sb.border_width_right = 1
	sb.border_width_top = 1
	sb.border_width_bottom = 1
	sb.border_color = border
	sb.content_margin_left = 6
	sb.content_margin_right = 6
	sb.content_margin_top = 2
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 2
	return sb"}

89: func _process(delta: float) -> void:
90: 	if not visible:
91: 		return
92: 	# 打开期间 0.5s 节流拉取 + 读最新行（host 立即回 _rpc_roster）
93: 	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
94: 	if now - _req_at >= REQ_INTERVAL:
95: 		_req_at = now
96: 		NetSession.send_command([NetSession.C_ROSTER])
97: 	rows = NetSession.get_roster_payload()
98: 	queue_redraw()

100: # host ui_scale() 同公式：maxf(1, 视口宽/2400) × 1.35（不写死分辨率）
101: func _us() -> float:
102: 	var vp := get_viewport()
103: 	if vp == null:
104: 		return UI_SCALE_EXTRA
105: 	return maxf(1.0, vp.get_visible_rect().size.x / BASE_W) * UI_SCALE_EXTRA
106: 
107: func _fs(base: float) -> float:
108: 	return float(int(round(base * _us())))
109: 
110: func _text(pos: Vector2, txt: String, sz: float, col: Color) -> void:
111: 	var isz := int(round(sz))
112: 	draw_string(_f, pos + Vector2(1.5, 1.5), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, isz, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55))
113: 	draw_string(_f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, isz, col)
114: 
115: func _tw(txt: String, sz: float) -> float:
116: 	return _f.get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, int(round(sz))).x
117: 
118: func _th(sz: float) -> float:
119: 	return _f.get_height(int(round(sz)))
120: 
121: func _asc(sz: float) -> float:
122: 	return _f.get_ascent(int(round(sz)))

124: # 纵向居中堆叠若干行文字（等价 host VBoxContainer）
125: func _vstack(x: float, center_y: float, txts: Array, szs: Array, cols: Array, sep: float) -> void:
126: 	var total := 0.0
127: 	for i in range(txts.size()):
128: 		total += _th(szs[i])
129: 		if i > 0:
130: 			total += sep
131: 	var y := center_y - total * 0.5
132: 	for i in range(txts.size()):
133: 		_text(Vector2(x, y + _asc(szs[i])), str(txts[i]), float(szs[i]), cols[i])
134: 		y += _th(szs[i]) + sep

136: func _panel_rect() -> Rect2:
137: 	var vp := get_viewport()
138: 	var area := (vp.get_visible_rect().size if vp != null else size)
139: 	# host hero_detail_panel：水平居中 2160 宽、垂直满高
140: 	return Rect2(Vector2((area.x - PANEL_W) * 0.5, 0.0), Vector2(PANEL_W, area.y))

142: # host close_btn：锚右上，offset -56..-6 / 6..56
143: func _close_rect(p: Rect2) -> Rect2:
144: 	return Rect2(Vector2(p.end.x - 56.0, p.position.y + 6.0), Vector2(CLOSE_W, CLOSE_W))

146: # host attribute_panel 尺寸：2列×9行 + 图例，全部 × ui_scale
147: func _attr_w() -> float:
148: 	var s := _us()
149: 	return ATTR_PAD * 2.0 * s + ATTR_COL_W * 2.0 * s + ATTR_GAP * s
150: 
151: func _attr_h() -> float:
152: 	var s := _us()
153: 	return ATTR_PAD * 2.0 * s + ATTR_LEGEND_H * s + ATTR_ROW_H * s * float(ATTR_ROWS_PER_COL)
154: 
155: # host 卡片高度公式（panel_h=1000、统计头 55、卡间距 4）→ 再按可用高度收紧防溢出
156: func _metrics(n: int, avail: float) -> Dictionary:
157: 	if n <= 0:
158: 		return {"h": CARD_MIN_H, "main": 12.0, "sub": 11.0}
159: 	var h := maxf(CARD_MIN_H, (1000.0 - TEAM_HDR_H - CARD_GAP * float(n)) / float(n))
160: 	h = maxf(CARD_MIN_H, minf(h, (avail - CARD_GAP * float(n)) / float(n)))
161: 	var fm := float(maxi(12, int(h / 4.2)))
162: 	return {"h": h, "main": fm, "sub": maxf(11.0, fm - 2.0)}
163: 
164: # host：按总经济降序
165: func _sorted() -> Array:
166: 	var out := rows.duplicate()
167: 	out.sort_custom(func(a, b): return int(a[9]) > int(b[9]))
168: 	return out

170: func _team_sum(list: Array, team: int) -> Array:
171: 	var gold := 0
172: 	var kills := 0
173: 	for e in list:
174: 		if int(e[2]) == team:
175: 			gold += int(e[9])
176: 			kills += int(e[6])
177: 	return [gold, kills]

179: func _gold_txt(v: int) -> String:
180: 	if v >= 1000:
181: 		return "%.1fk" % (float(v) / 1000.0)
182: 	return str(v)

184: func _draw() -> void:
185: 	var vp := get_viewport()
186: 	if vp == null:
187: 		return
188: 	var area := vp.get_visible_rect().size
189: 	var p := _panel_rect()
190: 	# 全屏遮罩（host hero_detail_dim 0.4）+ 黑底面板（host _apply_panel_style 0.88，无圆角无描边）
191: 	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, area), C_DIM)
192: 	draw_rect(p, C_PANEL_BG)
193: 	# 标题区：host hd_title(44,16) 28 金 / hd_sub(48,58) 13 灰 / 金线(44,82) 360×3
194: 	var t_sz := _fs(28)
195: 	_text(Vector2(p.position.x + 44.0, p.position.y + 16.0 + _asc(t_sz)), "战场信息", t_sz, Color.GOLD)
196: 	var s_sz := _fs(13)
197: 	var sub := "按总经济排序 · 点击空白处关闭"
198: 	if view == "attr":
199: 		sub = "按总经济排序 · 下方为本机英雄属性 · 点击空白处关闭"
200: 	_text(Vector2(p.position.x + 48.0, p.position.y + 58.0 + _asc(s_sz)), sub, s_sz, C_SUB)
201: 	draw_rect(Rect2(p.position + Vector2(44.0, 82.0), Vector2(360.0, 3.0)), C_GOLD_LINE)
202: 	# 右上关闭 ×（host close_btn 50×50 / 字号 26）
203: 	var cb := _close_rect(p)
204: 	var csb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
205: 	csb.bg_color = Color(0.22, 0.23, 0.26, 0.95)
206: 	csb.set_corner_radius_all(5)
207: 	csb.set_border_width_all(1)
208: 	csb.border_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.25)
209: 	draw_style_box(csb, cb)
210: 	var x_sz := _fs(26)
211: 	_text(Vector2(cb.position.x + (CLOSE_W - _tw("×", x_sz)) * 0.5,
212: 			cb.position.y + (CLOSE_W - _th(x_sz)) * 0.5 + _asc(x_sz)), "×", x_sz, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9))
213: 	# 名单：团队统计头 + 按总经济降序的单列英雄卡
214: 	var list := _sorted()
215: 	var attr_h := (_attr_h() + 16.0) if view == "attr" else 0.0
216: 	var avail := p.size.y - CONTENT_TOP - TEAM_HDR_H - 20.0 - attr_h - 16.0
217: 	var met := _metrics(list.size(), avail)
218: 	var card_h: float = float(met["h"])
219: 	var fm: float = float(met["main"])
220: 	var fs_: float = float(met["sub"])
221: 	var self_nid := int(own.get("nid", -1))
222: 	var y_hdr := p.position.y + CONTENT_TOP
223: 	_draw_team_header(p, y_hdr, list, _fs(fm + 2.0), _fs(fm), _fs(fm + 4.0))
224: 	draw_rect(Rect2(p.position.x + 8.0, y_hdr + TEAM_HDR_H + 6.0, PANEL_W - 16.0, 1.0), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.12))
225: 	var y_card := y_hdr + TEAM_HDR_H + 16.0
226: 	for e in list:
227: 		_draw_card(Rect2(Vector2(p.position.x, y_card), Vector2(PANEL_W, card_h)),
228: 				e, self_nid, _fs(fm), _fs(fs_))
229: 		y_card += card_h + CARD_GAP
230: 	if view == "attr":
231: 		_draw_attr_table(Vector2(p.position.x + 30.0, y_card + 16.0), self_nid)

253: func _draw_card(card: Rect2, e: Array, self_nid: int, fm: float, fs_: float) -> void:
254: 	var is_ally := int(e[2]) == 0
255: 	var is_own := int(e[0]) == self_nid
256: 	# 卡片底色/描边（host StyleBoxFlat：我方蓝底青边 / 敌方红底红边），自己额外加金边
257: 	draw_style_box(_sb_ally if is_ally else _sb_enemy, card)
258: 	if is_own:
259: 		draw_style_box(_sb_own, card)
260: 	var cy := card.position.y + card.size.y * 0.5
261: 	var x := card.position.x + 10.0   # border_left 4 + content_margin 6
262: 	# 1) 头像盘（host HeroDisc 60 宽：阵营外环 + 血量状态弧）
263: 	var maxhp := maxf(1.0, float(e[5]))
264: 	var ratio := clampf(float(e[4]) / maxhp, 0.0, 1.0)
265: 	_draw_disc(Rect2(Vector2(x, card.position.y + 2.0), Vector2(DISC_W, card.size.y - 4.0)), is_ally, ratio)
266: 	x += DISC_W + 8.0
267: 	# 2) 状态 / 名字 / 等级（host left_box 180 宽：font_main、font_main、font_sub，1px 行距）
268: 	var nm := str(e[1])
269: 	var name_col := Color.WHITE if is_ally else Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.55)
270: 	if is_own:
271: 		nm = ">> " + nm
272: 		name_col = Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.4)
273: 	_vstack(x, cy, ["存活", nm, "Lv.%d" % int(e[3])], [fm, fm, fs_],
274: 			[Color(0.3, 1.0, 0.4), name_col, Color.GOLD], 1.0)
275: 	# 3) 中间（属性圆徽章 + 技能行）、4) 右侧（KDA/总经济/装备）；右列按装备行宽撑开（host 每件 min 80）
276: 	var right_w := maxf(RIGHT_W, _equip_w(e))
277: 	var mid_x := x + LEFT_W + 8.0
278: 	var mid_r := card.end.x - 7.0 - right_w - 8.0
279: 	_draw_mid(mid_x, mid_r, cy, e, is_own, fs_)
280: 	var rx := card.end.x - 7.0 - right_w
281: 	_draw_right(Rect2(Vector2(rx, card.position.y + 2.0), Vector2(right_w, card.size.y - 4.0)), e, cy, fs_)
282: 
283: func _equip_w(e: Array) -> float:
284: 	var ek: Array = e[10]
285: 	var n := mini(ek.size(), 6)
286: 	if n <= 0:
287: 		return 0.0
288: 	return float(n) * (80.0 + 3.0) - 3.0

290: # host HeroDisc：暗内盘 + 阵营色外环 + 血量弧(绿→黄→红) + 职业字（roster 行无职业 → 「英」回退）
291: func _draw_disc(box: Rect2, is_ally: bool, ratio: float) -> void:
292: 	var c := box.position + box.size * 0.5
293: 	var r := minf(box.size.x, box.size.y) * 0.5 - 2.0
294: 	if r <= 4.0:
295: 		return
296: 	draw_circle(c, r, Color(0.02, 0.04, 0.07, 0.92))
297: 	draw_arc(c, r, 0, TAU, 32, C_ALLY if is_ally else C_ENEMY, 3.0, true)
298: 	if ratio > 0.0:
299: 		var hc := Color(0.35, 1.0, 0.5) if ratio > 0.5 else (Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.25) if ratio > 0.25 else Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.3))
300: 		draw_arc(c, r - 5.0, -PI / 2.0, -PI / 2.0 + TAU * ratio, 24, hc, 3.0, true)
301: 	var gs := float(int(r * 0.8))
302: 	if gs < 6.0:
303: 		return
304: 	draw_string(_f, Vector2(c.x - r, c.y + gs * 0.2), "英",
305: 			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, r * 2.0, int(gs), Color(0.9, 0.9, 0.9).lightened(0.25))
306: 
307: # 中间区：属性圆徽章行（host row_attrs：图标 20 + 4 间距 + 数值 tint.lightened(0.35)，chip 间距 14）
308: # + 技能行（host row_skills）。roster 行只带 攻/法/甲/抗/速，其余徽章与技能名需 host 补发。
309: func _draw_mid(x0: float, x1: float, cy: float, e: Array, is_own: bool, fs_: float) -> void:
310: 	var chips := [
311: 		["heart", Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55), "%d/%d" % [int(e[4]), int(e[5])]],
312: 		["sword", Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.24), "%d" % int(e[11])],
313: 		["spark", Color(0.72, 0.5, 1.0), "%d" % int(e[12])],
314: 		["shield", Color(1.0, 0.78, 0.3), "%d" % int(e[13])],
315: 		["gem", Color(0.4, 0.88, 1.0), "%d" % int(e[14])],
316: 		["chev", Color(0.45, 0.9, 0.7), "%.0f" % float(e[15])],
317: 	]
318: 	var skills := _skill_texts(is_own)
319: 	var icon := 20.0
320: 	var r1 := maxf(icon, _th(fs_))
321: 	var has_sk := skills.size() > 0
322: 	var r2 := _th(fs_) if has_sk else 0.0
323: 	var total := r1 + (1.0 + r2 if has_sk else 0.0)
324: 	var y1 := cy - total * 0.5
325: 	var cx := x0
326: 	for c in chips:
327: 		var t := str(c[2])
328: 		if cx + icon + 4.0 + _tw(t, fs_) > x1:
329: 			break
330: 		var tint: Color = c[1]
331: 		_draw_stat_icon(Vector2(cx + icon * 0.5, y1 + r1 * 0.5), icon * 0.5, str(c[0]), tint)
332: 		_text(Vector2(cx + icon + 4.0, y1 + (r1 - _th(fs_)) * 0.5 + _asc(fs_)), t, fs_, tint.lightened(0.35))
333: 		cx += icon + 4.0 + _tw(t, fs_) + 14.0
334: 	if not has_sk:
335: 		return
336: 	var y2 := y1 + r1 + 1.0
337: 	var sx := x0
338: 	for c in skills:
339: 		var t := str(c[0])
340: 		if sx + _tw(t, fs_) > x1:
341: 			break
342: 		var col: Color = c[1]
343: 		_text(Vector2(sx, y2 + _asc(fs_)), t, fs_, col)
344: 		sx += _tw(t, fs_) + 8.0

346: # host row_skills：技能「名 Lv.x (CD/就绪)」+ 召唤师技能。roster 行不带技能数据，
347: # 仅本机英雄能用 own 快照（levels/cd/summoner_name/summoner_cd）近似，其余留空。
348: func _skill_texts(is_own: bool) -> Array:
349: 	var out: Array = []
350: 	if not is_own:
351: 		return out
352: 	var lv: Array = own.get("levels", [])
353: 	var cd: Array = own.get("cd", [])
354: 	for i in range(mini(3, lv.size())):
355: 		if int(lv[i]) <= 0:
356: 			continue

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

Lambdas capture local variables by value; `self` is accessible inside lambda (Callable bound to object instance?
```
	out.sort_custom(_sort_by_gold)
func _sort_by_gold(a: Array, b: Array) -> bool:

```
Callable(to self method) works reliably. Do that.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

_team_sum returns [gold, kills] currently. Change to [gold, exp, kills] and add `has_exp` flag? Simpler: return [gold, exp_sum, kills, has_exp]. Or compute exp only for rows with size>25; if no row has exp → old format.

Implement:
```gdscript
# 团队合计：经济=total_gold 合计 / 击杀 合计 / 经验（P3h：仅当行 >25 段才求和）
func _team_sum(list: Array, team: int) -> Array:
	var gold := 0
	var kills := 0
	var exp := 0
	var has_exp := false
	for e in list:
		if int(e[2]) != team:
			continue
		gold += _gold_total(e)
		kills += int(e[6])
		if e.size() > 25:
			exp += int(e[25])
			has_exp = true
	return [gold, exp, kills, has_exp]
```
Then _draw_team_header:
```gdscript
	var ally := _team_sum(list, 0)
	var enemy := _team_sum(list, 1)
	var has_exp := bool(ally[3]) or bool(enemy[3])
	var a_info := _team_info(ally, has_exp)
	var e_info := _team_info(enemy, has_exp)
```
helper:
```gdscript
# host 团队头信息行：经济: %s  经验: %d  击杀: %d（旧载荷无 [25] exp 时省略经验段）
func _team_info(t: Array, has_exp: bool) -> String:
	if has_exp:
		return "经济: %s  经验: %d  击杀: %d" % [_gold_txt(int(t[0])), int(t[1]), int(t[2])]
	return "经济: %s  击杀: %d" % [_gold_txt(int(t[0])), int(t[2])]
```

Note: has_exp per team—if ally rows have exp but enemy none (old payload impossible since same payload), using global has_exp consistent. If mixed (impossible), ally shows exp and enemy shows 0 exp. Fine.

				["drop", Color(0.3, 0.7, 1.0), "300/500"],
				["clock", Color(0.5, 0.85, 1.0), "40%"]])   # [22]
			row.append([["技能1 Lv.3 (就绪)", Color.LIGHT_CYAN],
				["闪现 (就绪)", Color.GOLD]])                 # [23]
			row.append([["暗影战斧 CD:12s", Color.LIGHT_GREEN]]) # [24]

	return out

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

4: ## 存到 user://hero_builds.json（不可写时退回项目内 res://saves/hero_builds.json）；
5: ## 选人页可把某套方案设为「本局推荐出装」。

8: const SAVE_PATH := "user://hero_builds.json"
9: const FALLBACK_PATH := "res://saves/hero_builds.json"
10: const MAX_SLOTS := 6
11: const MAX_SCHEMES := 6
12: 
13: static var _data: Dictionary = {}
14: static var _loaded := false
15: 
16: 
17: static func _ensure_loaded() -> void:
18: 	if _loaded:
19: 		return
20: 	_loaded = true
21: 	for p in [SAVE_PATH, FALLBACK_PATH]:
22: 		if not FileAccess.file_exists(p):
23: 			continue
24: 		var f := FileAccess.open(p, FileAccess.READ)
25: 		if f == null:
26: 			continue
27: 		var txt := f.get_as_text()
28: 		f.close()
29: 		var parsed = JSON.parse_string(txt)
30: 		if parsed is Dictionary:
31: 			_data = parsed
32: 			return
33: 
34: 
35: static func _flush() -> void:
36: 	var txt := JSON.stringify(_data, "\t")
37: 	var f := FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
38: 	if f != null:
39: 		f.store_string(txt)
40: 		f.close()
41: 		return
42: 	# 受限环境（如编辑器沙箱）user:// 不可写 → 退回项目内 saves/
43: 	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute("res://saves")
44: 	var f2 := FileAccess.open(FALLBACK_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
45: 	if f2 != null:
46: 		f2.store_string(txt)
47: 		f2.close()
48: 
49: 
50: ## 某英雄已保存的方案列表：[{ "name": String, "items": Array }]
51: static func get_builds(hero_name: String) -> Array:
52: 	_ensure_loaded()
53: 	var list: Array = _data.get(hero_name, [])
54: 	var out: Array = []
55: 	for b in list:
56: 		if b is Dictionary:
57: 			out.append({"name": str(b.get("name", "")), "items": (b.get("items", []) as Array).duplicate()})
58: 	return out
59: 
60: 
61: ## 保存/覆盖同名方案；返回 "" 表示成功，否则为错误提示
62: static func save_build(hero_name: String, build_name: String, items: Array) -> String:
63: 	_ensure_loaded()
64: 	var clean_name := build_name.strip_edges()
65: 	if hero_name == "":
66: 		return "未选择英雄"
67: 	if clean_name == "":
68: 		return "方案名不能为空"
69: 	var clean_items: Array = []
70: 	for it in items:
71: 		var id := str(it)
72: 		if id != "" and not clean_items.has(id):
73: 			clean_items.append(id)
74: 	if clean_items.is_empty():
75: 		return "方案里还没有装备"
76: 	if clean_items.size() > MAX_SLOTS:
77: 		clean_items = clean_items.slice(0, MAX_SLOTS)
78: 	var list: Array = _data.get(hero_name, [])
79: 	var idx := -1
80: 	for i in list.size():
81: 		if str((list[i] as Dictionary).get("name", "")) == clean_name:
82: 			idx = i
83: 			break
84: 	if idx >= 0:
85: 		list[idx] = {"name": clean_name, "items": clean_items}
86: 	elif list.size() >= MAX_SCHEMES:
87: 		return "该英雄最多保存 %d 套方案" % MAX_SCHEMES
88: 	else:
89: 		list.append({"name": clean_name, "items": clean_items})
90: 	_data[hero_name] = list
91: 	_flush()
92: 	return ""
93: 
94: 
95: static func delete_build(hero_name: String, build_name: String) -> void:
96: 	_ensure_loaded()
97: 	var list: Array = _data.get(hero_name, [])
98: 	for i in range(list.size() - 1, -1, -1):
99: 		if str((list[i] as Dictionary).get("name", "")) == build_name:
100: 			list.remove_at(i)
101: 	if list.is_empty():
102: 		_data.erase(hero_name)
103: 	else:
104: 		_data[hero_name] = list
105: 	_flush()
106: 
107: 
108: ## 是否存在某英雄的任何方案
109: static func has_builds(hero_name: String) -> bool:
110: 	return not get_builds(hero_name).is_empty()

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

Layout: bottom bar h=300 with left (hero strip) and right panel 520 wide containing summoner grid (scroll 120) + status + summary + buttons. Right panel is already dense. Adding build schemes there would be cramped.

Better approach: add build scheme row into center stage overlay (bottom, above tip), i.e., in `_build_center_stage`'s VBox `v`, add a build row between chips row and tip: label "出装方案" + horizontal HBox of buttons (3 presets + saved builds + 恢复推荐). Buttons tooltip 6 item names; click writes ItemDatabase.set_recommended_override(hero, ids) and highlights selection.
